inland-waterways-left.description: Theodore Roosevelt and Gifford Pinchot on the deck of a steamer during the Inland Waterways Commission trip down the Mississippi, October 1907.
inland-waterways-left.collection: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.
inland-waterways-left.credit_line: Theodore Roosevelt and Gifford Pinchot aboard the Inland Waterways Commission steamer on the Mississippi, 1907. Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division. One frame of a stereograph card; the second frame, the publisher's mount and the burned-in negative number have been cropped away.

cascade-lumbering.collection: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.
cascade-lumbering.credit_line: Lumbering in the Cascade Mountains near Seattle, Washington - a turn of logs at the No. 2 road donkey, Davidson and Caskey camps. Photograph copyright 1899 by D. R. Kinsey. Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division. Decorative border and the photographer's printed copyright line cropped away.

big-trees.collection: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.
big-trees.credit_line: The nation's chief before the forest king - President Roosevelt at the Giant, Big Tree Grove, Santa Cruz, California, 1903. Photograph by Underwood & Underwood. Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division. One frame of a stereograph card; the second frame, the publisher's mount and the printed caption cropped away.
